summary: CenterPoint Energy filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for a $700 million public offering of 6.400% Fixed-to-Fixed Reset Rate Junior Subordinated Notes due 2058, issued under its existing S-3 shelf. Underwriters include Mizuho, PNC, Scotia, TD, and U.S. Bancorp. The notes are unsecured, subordinated, with interest resetting after 2033 at Five-Year Treasury plus 1.885% with a 6.400% floor. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. What to watch: no special-situation angle; focus is on execution and pricing terms.
